summary: OpenAI published a patch release (v0.0.2) of its Symphony agent-orchestration tool, adding several issue-tracker adapters (Linear, GitHub Issues, Jira Cloud, Asana, GitLab) and fixing workspace, retry and tool-input handling bugs.

practices.reason: Teams building on Symphony would need to know new tracker adapters (Linear, Jira, Asana, GitLab, GitHub Issues) are available as integration points for agent workflows.
practices.quote: Add generic tracker interface with Linear adapter by @frantic-openai in https://github.com/openai/symphony/pull/102
